messages:
Alex Chen: quick layout problem on narrow screens: filter chips in the compare table wrap and push header actions off-screen. i mocked three fixes: +N overflow, horizontally scrollable chips, or move filters into a left-side drawer. thoughts? Maya Patel: +N overflow from me. keeps header tidy and shows count of hidden filters. need SR text like "Show 3 hidden filters" and a clear keyboard target though. Samir Gupta: horizontal scroll looks neat but keyboard focus order is a nightmare. drawer is too heavy for quick toggles. +N is pragmatic if implemented accessibly. Taylor Nguyen: agree. for mobile the overflow should open full-screen multi-select. tooltip on hover and aria-expanded on the button please. Alex Chen: also flagged: performance badges have low contrast and a11y-bot complained. current gray-on-white for some badges won't pass. Maya Patel: i'll propose new tokens: darker teal for "fast", richer amber for "cheap". aim for >=4.5:1 for small text badges and 3:1 for decorative. will update copy too: change "Pinned v1.2.3" to "Pinned v1.2.3" — actually maybe use a mid-dot: "Pinned v1.2.3" (we'll finalize glyph). a11y-bot: guidance: small text (<18px) needs contrast >=4.5:1. interactive controls must have visible focus (3:1). Add aria-label like `aria-label=\"Show hidden filters (3)\"` and manage `aria-expanded`. Announce number on open with an SR-only message. Samir Gupta: prototype snippet i used: ```html
  • Model size
  • Token latency
``` Taylor Nguyen: ensure ArrowDown lands on first item, Escape closes, and add an SR announcement like "3 additional filters available" when opened. Alex Chen: decision: implement +N overflow for chip overflow, mobile full-screen multi-select, tabbable menu with Arrow/Escape keyboard behavior, aria-label/expanded and SR announcement, bump badge contrast to WCAG thresholds, and change pinned copy to use a mid-dot separator: "Pinned B7 vX.Y.Z". Alex Chen: action items: @Taylor update prototype interactions (EOW), @Maya update badge tokens + microcopy and open PR, @Samir create QA checklist for keyboard + screen reader, i'll add a Cypress keyboard test and rollout notes. Maya Patel: i'll include color swatches and contrast numbers in the PR. Samir Gupta: i'll test with NVDA and VoiceOver and report issues. Taylor Nguyen: i'll upload a short loom of the updated prototype when ready :thumbsup:
